title: Stopping Remote Code Execution (RCE) with Wasm Sandboxes
content_md:
WebAssembly is an open and secure W3C standard leveraged in clouds, edges, browsers, and IOT. The WebAssembly System Interface (WASI) gives you POSIX like server side functionallity for code, that dramatically reduces your attack surface and vulnerability to TTPs like those listedin MITRE ATT&CK. Case study, in Sandboxing a recent CVSS 10.00 RCE with Cosmonic / CNCF wasmCloud: Blog: https://cosmonic.com/blog/stopping-remote-code-execution-with-a-sandbox/ submitted by /u/HectaMan [link] [comments]
